name: Country Dancing with Natalie
description: Natalie Boyle's country line dancing lessons on Long Island. Her website lists her weekly classes at halls, libraries and bars, a weekly roundup of places to hear country music and dance, and beginner line dance video courses. She also teaches private lessons and parties.

evidence.note: Lessons page: Natalie Boyle teaches country line dancing to the songs local bands and DJs play, all levels welcome; lists her class places and offers private lessons and parties.
Events page: a weekly roundup of Long Island country nights, with her own classes marked "with Natalie"; (631) 601-5109 is the number to call to sign up for a class.
Courses page sells two beginner line dance video courses.

reviewNotes: Added 2026-10-06 (issue #41). The phone is the sign-up number on her Events page; Yellow Pages lists it for Country Dancing With Natalie (Rocky Point), so it is her business line. Her site's social icons are blank placeholders and the footer email is a template address, so no social links or email are recorded. A YouTube channel "Natalie Boyle Dancing" looks like hers but her site does not link to it. The contact page is a form only.
